title.zh: 医疗服务（心理卫生学院）（豁免）命令 2023
title.en: Healthcare Services (Institute of Mental Health) (Exemption) Order 2023

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Healthcare Services (Institute of Mental Health) (Exemption) Order 2023 and comes into operation on 26 June 2023.

3.—(1) NHG is exempt from regulations 16, 18, 20 and 24 of the Healthcare Services (Acute Hospital Service) Regulations 2023 in respect of the provision of a blood transfusion service, an intensive care service and a surgical service, respectively, at the specified premises.
(2) NHG is exempt from regulation 26 of the Healthcare Services (Acute Hospital Service) Regulations 2023 in respect of the use of any of the terms mentioned in that regulation, or any abbreviation or derivation of those terms, at or in relation to the specified premises.
(3) NHG is exempt from regulation 40(1) and (2) of the Healthcare Services (Acute Hospital Service) Regulations 2023 in respect of the provision of a clinical laboratory service at the specified premises, if NHG appoints, and makes arrangements with, a clinical laboratory service licensee to provide a clinical laboratory service to every patient who requires the clinical laboratory service, whether at the specified premises or any approved permanent premises of the clinical laboratory service licensee.
(4) NHG is exempt from regulation 41(1) and (2) of the Healthcare Services (Acute Hospital Service) Regulations 2023 in respect of the provision of a radiological service at the specified premises, if NHG appoints, and makes arrangements with, a radiological service licensee to provide a radiological service to every patient who requires the radiological service, whether at the specified premises or any approved permanent premises of the radiological service licensee.
